situation.beyondsolo.foe.survive.desc: %s outclasses you. Stay alive for one minute. Wound it badly enough and the hunter becomes the hunted.
situation.beyondsolo.foe.annihilate.desc: %s is breaking. Finish it before it recovers.
situation.beyondsolo.foe.fury.desc: %s refuses to fall and turns its fury on you. Weather the storm and it will be spent.
situation.beyondsolo.foe.nemesis.desc: %s has tracked you down, stronger than before. It will keep coming back until one of you falls. (Returns: %s)
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.felled: You brought down %s before it could kill you.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.it_fell: %s fell, though not by your hand.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.escaped_hun: You got away, but %s has your scent.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.let_go_hunt: You let %s get away. It will be back.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.nemesis_aga: %s slipped away again. It will return.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.nemesis_los: %s slipped away for the last time.
situation.beyondsolo.last_stand.stand.de: You are on the brink of death. Hold on. Do not give in.
situation.beyondsolo.last_stand.second_w: You held on, and the System answers. Strike back now: %s kills before the strength fades.
situation.beyondsolo.pack.head: Head of the Pack
situation.beyondsolo.pack.head.desc: %s leads a pack of %s. Cut off the head and the rest will falter.
situation.beyondsolo.pack.rout.desc: %s has fallen and its pack wavers. Finish them before they regroup.
situation.beyondsolo.pack.obj.rest: Defeat the rest of the pack
situation.beyondsolo.protect.protect.des: %s is under attack. Drive off the attackers before it is too late.
situation.beyondsolo.protect.avenge.desc: %s is dead, and %s is still out there. Make it pay.
situation.beyondsolo.protect.thanks: Thank you, hunter! Please, take these: %s emeralds.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.too_slow_pr: You were too slow to help %s.
situation.beyondsolo.raid.defend.desc: Raiders are attacking the village. Hold them off through all %s waves.
situation.beyondsolo.raid.final_wave.des: The last wave is here: %s raiders. Break them and the village is saved.
situation.beyondsolo.beyond_rank.clear.d: This is a %s-rank gate, and you are only %s-rank. Clear it, and the System will take note.
situation.beyondsolo.beyond_rank.retreat: You are out of your depth. Get out of the gate alive. There is no shame in surviving.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.beyond_clea: You cleared a gate beyond your rank.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.retreated: You live to fight another day.
situation.beyondsolo.untouchable.tier1.d: Nothing has laid a hand on you. Defeat %s creatures without being hit.
situation.beyondsolo.untouchable.tier2.d: The System is watching. %s more, and still without a scratch.
situation.beyondsolo.untouchable.tier3.d: They cannot even touch you. %s more for perfection.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.streak_bank: The streak is broken. Tiers already paid: %s.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.streak_brok: You were hit. The streak is broken.
situation.beyondsolo.frenzy.tier1.desc: You are on a rampage. Defeat %s creatures within %s seconds.
situation.beyondsolo.frenzy.tier2.desc: Do not stop now. %s more within %s seconds.
situation.beyondsolo.frenzy.tier3.desc: Nothing can stand before you. %s more within %s seconds.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.frenzy_fade: The frenzy fades. Tiers already paid: %s.
situation.beyondsolo.catch_breath.rest.d: You made it, barely. Rest for %s seconds without fighting, and the System will help you back on your feet.
situation.beyondsolo.cure.cure.desc: This zombie was once a villager. Weaken it with a splash potion of Weakness, then give it a golden apple.
situation.beyondsolo.cure.wait.desc: The cure has begun. Keep the villager safe until it takes hold.
situation.beyondsolo.outcome.cure_died: It died before the cure took hold.
situation.beyondsolo.silent_city.explore: An ancient city lies in silence. Loot %s of its chests without waking what sleeps below.
situation.beyondsolo.silent_city.awakene: %s has woken. Get out of the city, now.
situation.beyondsolo.outpost.clear.desc: A raider outpost, %s raiders strong. Clear it out.
situation.beyondsolo.outpost.hold.desc: Their reinforcements are here: %s raiders. Hold the outpost.
situation.beyondsolo.ruins.search.desc: Something was left behind in these ruins. Search %s hiding places: chests, pots, or the sand and gravel that hide old things.
situation.beyondsolo.ruins.guardian.desc: Your search woke %s. Defeat the guardian of the ruins.
situation.beyondsolo.revenge.hunt.desc: %s killed you, and it is still out there where you fell. Go back and bring it down.
secret.beyondsolo.giant_slayer.desc: Bring down a creature far stronger than yourself.
secret.beyondsolo.giant_slayer.deed: You brought down a creature far beyond your strength.
secret.beyondsolo.unbroken.desc: Hold on at the edge of death until the very end.
secret.beyondsolo.unbroken.obj: Endure a Last Stand to the end
secret.beyondsolo.valor.desc: Defend a village through an entire raid.
secret.beyondsolo.valor.obj: Save a village from a raid
secret.beyondsolo.valor.deed: The village stands because of you.
secret.beyondsolo.untouched.desc: Clear a gate without a single creature landing a blow on you.
secret.beyondsolo.untouched.deed: Nothing in the gate so much as touched you.
secret.beyondsolo.lone_wolf.desc: Clear a gate above your rank, alone.
secret.beyondsolo.nemesis_slain.desc: Put down a creature that kept coming back for you.
secret.beyondsolo.flawless.desc: Finish every tier of an Untouchable streak without being hit.
secret.beyondsolo.unstoppable.desc: Keep a Frenzy going through every tier.
secret.beyondsolo.silent.desc: Plunder the silent city without waking what sleeps below.
